mapper.select: select id, chapter_id, lesson_id, seq, start_ms, end_ms, section, text from course_transcript where chapter_id = #{chapterId} order by lesson_id asc, seq asc
select id, chapter_id, lesson_id, seq, start_ms, end_ms, section, text from course_transcript where lesson_id = #{lessonId} order by seq asc

select t.id, t.chapter_id, t.lesson_id, t.seq, t.start_ms, t.end_ms, t.section, t.text from course_transcript t where t.lesson_id = ( select l.id from course_lesson l where l.chapter_id = #{chapterId} and exists (select 1 from course_transcript t2 where t2.lesson_id = l.id) order by l.lesson_no asc limit 1 ) order by t.seq asc
mapper.insert:
insert into course_transcript (chapter_id, lesson_id, seq, start_ms, end_ms, section, text) values
